theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Technology (+4.35%) and Materials (+1.92%) led the market today, while Energy (-0.48%) and Utilities (-0.43%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +1.84% versus -0.08% for defensives and +0.77% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +1.79%, Dow +1.71%, Nasdaq +2.59% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +1.85%. The VIX rose 4.04% to 16.50, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.84% to $4,221.70, crude oil was little changed at $75.15, and bitcoin gained 0.37% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
